item.text: I’ll enable GNOME’s built-in battery percentage setting so it appears in the top bar next to the battery indicator.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface show-battery-percentage true && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface show-battery-percentage'
/bin/bash -lc 'gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface show-battery-percentage true && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface show-battery-percentage'

item.text: Battery percentage display is enabled. You should now see the percentage in the top bar next to the battery indicator.
